hero.heading: A friendly club running events across Cornwall.
hero.lede: Cornwall Orienteering Club, known as KERNO, was formed in 1982 and has around 200 members. We're a member of the South West Orienteering Association (SWOA), affiliated to British Orienteering, run entirely by volunteers, and we welcome anyone who wants to give the sport a try, from families out for a walk to competitors racing across Britain.

whatWeDo.heading: Events most months, plus permanent courses.
whatWeDo.body:
We hold an event at least once a month, usually on a weekend morning, on a wide range of areas across Cornwall using specially drawn orienteering maps that are regularly updated. Our calendar mixes woodland and parkland events with urban and coastal races.
KERNO also helps maintain permanent orienteering courses in Cornwall that you can run any day of the year. And when we're not putting on an event, you'll often find our members competing further afield, at British Orienteering's major events such as the JK and the British Championships, and on the City Race Euro Tour urban series.

whereWeCover.heading: From the far west to the Tamar.
whereWeCover.body:
KERNO maps and runs events the length of Cornwall, from Penzance and the far west through Camborne, Truro, Falmouth, Newquay and St Austell to Bodmin and the Tamar valley. Terrain ranges from town parks and coastal paths to woodland and open moor.
The map library lists the venues we currently use, with notes on access, parking and terrain.

committee.heading: Run by volunteers, every one of us.
committee.body: KERNO has no paid staff. Every event, map survey, results upload and newsletter happens because a volunteer puts the time in. We're always glad of help, so if you can plan, control, organise registration, take photos or run a social account, please [get in touch](/contacts).

membership.heading: Join KERNO.
membership.body: There's no fee to join KERNO itself; you simply take out British Orienteering membership, which also makes you a member of the South West Orienteering Association. Membership gives you public liability insurance at events, discounted entry, member discounts, and results that count toward the British Orienteering ranking system.

firstTime.heading: Try an event and see why we love it!
firstTime.body:
Try an event and see why we love it!
Whether it’s a low-key Wednesday Street O events, or a weekend terrain one, all of our events are friendly and welcoming. KERNO members will talk you through anything you may need to know or may be unsure of, especially if it's your first time, and the emphasis at all our events is for those taking part to have enjoyed themselves.
